_why: forge station rules (contract station-forge section 1): every station mechanism named by one rule, each with its enforcement (hook / check / NOT HOOKABLE + reason). Loaded with governance/rules.json by gov_check.py rules and gen_ownership.py. No commons rule is overridden (DEC-forge-0001).

rules.headline: A tool is adopted only on a TRIAL row: N >= 5 frozen tasks without and with it, graded, the authors' failed runs read; verdict promote or park
rules.earned_by: KIT_PLAN 4 forge job 'tool trial (N >= 5, with and without the tool)'; gap skill tool-trial test

rules.headline: An evo optimise run freezes a holdout before its first experiment; every gain is in-sample until re-measured on it
rules.earned_by: KIT_PLAN 4 forge job 'evo optimise loop with a frozen holdout'; gap skill evo-guard test

rules.headline: A telemetry row is verified only with the offline status run recorded; a tool whose row is unverified is never started by a workflow
rules.earned_by: KIT_PLAN 6 telemetry rows are claims; registry/telemetry.json rule (J2 GA6); gap skill telemetry-audit test

rules.headline: Reverse engineering runs only after a work/re/legal_gate.json row with decision proceed; third-party proprietary targets need a stated right
rules.earned_by: KIT_PLAN 4 forge job 'reverse engineering behind re-legal-gate'; REA DISCLAIMER.md (held, read as data)

rules.headline: A pin moves only through tools/kit/repin.py: a report first, any STOP item (licence blob change, new agent files) stops, --apply only when green
rules.earned_by: KIT_PLAN 4 forge job 'repin an upstream with the repin report'; R-upstream-pinned

rules.headline: Forge holds tooling, never client, customer or identity data: wiki and RE targets are this kit's or public non-client repositories

enforcement.why: whether a repository or binary is a client's is a fact about its origin, not its path or a tool call; the wiki-gen and reverse workflows refuse in their target-check stage, and act_gate asks before openwiki auth/ingest (identity-bearing sources)

rules.earned_by: KIT_PLAN 4.2 forge boundary; LEAN CA-10 / LL-04 (the noun decides the station)

rules.headline: Upstream CLIs (evo, openwiki, ProjectAtlas, REA) run only in a run-tree outside the station with telemetry opt-out env set; their plugin hooks are never installed
rules.earned_by: JUDGE_2 G2 (evo's PreToolUse '.*' hook pipes full hook stdin to an external binary); R-no-upstream-plugin-install; station.json irreversible_acts lists the plugin-install and telemetry-toggle commands

rules.headline: A trial verdict or an optimise gain carries noise_floor K >= 5 and spread; a gain not larger than the spread is never promoted or called out-of-sample
rules.earned_by: router/REASSIGN.md gap G2: neither evo-guard nor tool-trial measured run-to-run variance; LEAN every numerator carries its denominator

rules.headline: An architecture recommendation compares at least two radically different designs in a depth table before its pick
rules.earned_by: router/REASSIGN.md gap G1: STATION.md promised 'design it twice' and no held skill carried the step

rules.headline: A station workflow's verdict is its certain test on the deliverable (forge_check.py output <kind> <path>), never a path-existence check; each workflow's DEFAULT_MODELS equals station.json gov.model_roster
rules.earned_by: LEAN F1: the planned certain tests were station_audit -k paths, which cannot fail on a wrong result
